warfarin.t: Dicloxacillin may reduce the anticoagulant response to dicumarol and warfarin.

anticoag.t: Dicloxacillin may reduce the anticoagulant response to dicumarol and warfarin.
Careful monitoring of prothrombin times is suggested during concomitant therapy, and dosage of the anticoagulant should be adjusted as required.
